protocol: uint8-quantized observation RGB, unit PSNR, zero-padded 11x11 SSIM sigma1.5; LPIPS standard [-1,1]; raw_MSE is unclipped observation MSE; original held-out camera calibration
camera_protocol: saved training offsets on fit frames; original calibration on held-out frames
observation_protocol: PNG foreground gamma then alpha composition; HDR full-image gamma
highlight_protocol: Neutral bright/desaturated local peaks in uint8-quantized observation RGB; target-alpha interior; 11x11 contrast window; 2px Chebyshev matching; counts and target-peak pixels pooled across frames. GT 8-connected component area buckets 1-4, 5-16 and >16 pixels pool raw pixel/component sums; component any-hit also accepts broad or displaced predicted peaks. Image proxy, not physical specular ground truth.
